tail.statement: The COMPLETE original finite residual, after its retained exact low cancellations, satisfies |F(U^[N])|_m<=C_Nm*q^(2h(N+1)-(2A+1+m)).
tail.support: Every high residual term has a positive-order coefficient, or a derivative of the compact leading v0 in the exceptional N=1 shifted radial viscosity. Thus it has common compact radial support; no leading heat tail is truncated.

partialVelocity.statement: Every fixed physical derivative through m of the ORIGINAL uncut finite velocity sum is <=C_Nm*q^(-(2A+m)); C_Nm is an actual finite sum of complete source FTC constants.
